name: desktop-photoshop-mcp
description: Safely control local Photoshop 2020 through a guarded Windows COM MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Control local Photoshop with guarded COM automation.
interface.longDescription: Installs a pinned local Photoshop 2020 MCP runtime, discovers the Windows application dynamically, disables unavailable generative tools, and keeps arbitrary-script operations behind explicit approval prompts.
defaultPrompt: 检查本机 Photoshop MCP 状态，并告诉我可用的操作。
在 Photoshop 中按要求编辑当前文档，保存前先征求确认。
诊断 Photoshop MCP 连接，但不要执行任何写操作。
